product: macOS Manager App Store edition compatibility table
statement: Facts below were read from public Apple Support pages on 2026-11-06. A model is listed for a macOS version only when its exact Apple model name appears on that version's compatibility page. Factory macOS is not on these identify pages and is omitted. A published download link is not a statement that Software Update currently offers that installer for a particular Mac. This App Store edition table omits Apple CDN disk-image installer URLs. Those versions open Apple's official How to download macOS support article instead.
